verses.text: At this my heart pounds and jumps out of its place.
Listen! Listen to the roar of his voice, the rumbling that comes from his mouth.
He sends his lightning across the whole sky, to the ends of the earth.
After the lightning comes a roaring sound. He thunders with his majestic voice. He does not hold back the lightning when his voice is heard.
God's voice thunders in amazing ways. He does great things we cannot understand.
He says to the snow, 'Fall on the earth.' He tells the rain to pour down, and the heavy rain to fall.
He stops all people from working, so everyone he made may know his power.
The animals go into their shelters and stay in their dens.
The storm comes out of its room, and the cold comes from the north wind.
God's breath makes ice, and the wide waters freeze over.
He loads the thick clouds with water and scatters his lightning through them.
They swirl around wherever he directs them, doing whatever he commands them all over the face of the earth.
He sends the clouds to punish people, or to water his land, or to show his faithful love.
Listen to this, Job. Stop and think about God's amazing works.
Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?
Do you know how the clouds hang in the sky, the amazing works of the one who knows everything?
You sweat in your clothes when the land is quiet under the hot south wind.
Can you help him spread out the skies, which are as hard as a mirror made of bronze?
Tell us what we should say to him. We cannot make our case, because we are in the dark.
Should he be told that I want to speak? Would anyone ask to be swallowed up?
No one can look at the sun when it shines brightly in the sky after the wind has cleared the clouds away.
Golden light comes from the north. God comes in amazing majesty.
We cannot reach the Almighty. He is great in power. He is fair and completely right, and he does not crush people.
That is why people respect him. He does not pay attention to those who think they are wise."
